extraction.Name: Elizabeth Stirk, nee Cottier
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent to her allotment, on account of paying taxes, that she refused it, but that she got two different letters, advising her to accept it, which she did
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged her 160 acres, to the State Bank of Scenic, Scenic, South Dakota, to get money to pay taxes on it, as well as on the allotment of her husband, George Stirk, and other debts. This mortgage was foreclosed about 1926.
extraction.Buyer: State Bank of Scenic, Scenic, South Dakota (foreclosed approximately 1926)
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: mortgaged to get money to pay taxes on it, as well as on the allotment of her husband, George Stirk, and other debts
extraction.NOTES: Husband is George Stirk; husband's allotment is an improved place, hers is just raw land; she wanted to save the husband's allotment in preference to hers; mentally competent; good health; health of entire family is good; has never received any aid from the County or United States Government; document dated November 13, 1928; signed with mark (illegible signature)
